test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution: The incorrectly spelt word is: **Milennium** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is "**Millennium**" with double **L **and double **N**. • The word refers to a period of one thousand years. (एक हजार वर्ष की अवधि) • **For example-** The year 2000 marked the beginning of a new millennium. Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Subpoena **is the correct spelling. It refers to a legal document ordering someone to appear in court. (किसी को अदालत में उपस्थित होने का आदेश देने वाला कानूनी दस्तावेज़) • **Noticeable **is the correct spelling. It means easily seen or noticed. (आसानी से देखा या नोटिस किया जा सकता है) • **Caucus **is the correct spelling. It refers to a meeting of members of a political party or group. (किसी राजनीतिक दल या समूह के सदस्यों की बैठक) ea:T956, The correct answer is: **Timid**
